title: Print mode is what lets a CI job finish
expected_outcome: claude -p processes the prompt, writes one JSON envelope to stdout and exits well inside the job timeout; no terminal is ever waited on.

t1.command: claude -p Nightly support triage check: read only stock/jobs.py and answer in… --model claude-haiku-5-5 --output-format json --max-turns 5 --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools Read Grep Glob
t1.result:
Yes, if `api.get_stock` raises for an unknown SKU. `sync` has no lookup or try/except of its own, so any exception from `api.get_stock` propagates and aborts the whole batch.

I read only `stock/jobs.py` as asked, so I haven't confirmed how `api.get_stock` handles unknown SKUs. That would need a look at `stock/api.py`.

evaluation.criterion: the job exited on its own with a JSON envelope (session_id present)
it returned inside a CI-friendly time budget
learner can explain why timeouts, retries or 'please exit' instructions do not change the execution mode
